fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (34.5037,-93.0552) landed in dense downtown Hot Springs / Central Ave retail fabric (z17 confirmed small commercial blocks, no DC). Web search resolved the Mountain Valley Spring Water DISTRIBUTION CENTER / WAREHOUSE to 121 Technology Pl, Hot Springs National Park AR 71913 (Wanderlog 'Mountain Valley Warehouse' + TruckMap + driver reviews about loading/wait times; LoopNet parcel APN 200-44950-012-000). Google geocoded 121 Technology Pl to ROOFTOP at 34.5157,-93.1243, landing on the central warehouse complex of the Hot Springs industrial park ~5km WNW of downtown and DISTINCT from both the idx-29 legacy bottling plant (283 Mountain Valley Water Pl, Hot Springs Village) and the idx-31 new factory. Locked DC center to 34.5157,-93.1238 (the central two-building warehouse complex with active truck docks).
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. Street View (pano bEbZKAxSNWYBe7cHw9S9cg, 2023-11, on the access road N of the building) shows an OPEN industrial access road running straight to the dock apron and yard. No barrier arm, no sliding/swing gate, no pinch-point checkpoint across the truck lane. Only a one-way 'Do Not Enter' road sign on a median post. The 2025-08 pano further E shows chain-link fencing only around a SEPARATE adjacent vehicle/equipment lot, not the Mountain Valley dock approach. High confidence open site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at the entrance in Street View or satellite. The approach has a portable toilet and a dumpster but no guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Eastern (main) warehouse NW face: a continuous dock bank with trailers backed in. z20/z21 imagery shows ~7-9 trailers (orange tractors + white box trailers) on the apron over a bank of roughly 12-16 doors. The western building and the smaller north wing add a few more. Honest total ~18; banded 10-25. Banding low-confidence (sits near the 10-25/25-50 boundary; some apron doors are obscured).
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated marked trailer-storage stall lot with bobtailed trailers visible; the trailers present are tractor-attached at the docks. A few empties may sit on the apron. Banded 0-10. dropYard set FALSE.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on one NW-facing bank of the main building; no clearly separate second ship/receive dock cluster on a different face confirmed. FALSE, low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - the Mountain Valley footprint is two large connected/adjacent warehouse buildings (a central eastern building with the dock bank + an L-shaped western building) forming one campus; treated as a 2-building cluster.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two primary large warehouse buildings counted as the Mountain Valley DC complex; the other industrial buildings in the park belong to separate tenants and are excluded.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Open access road plus a deep paved/gravel yard apron easily holds a 3+ truck queue before the docks; no backup-onto-public-road risk given the large internal yard. backupSensitive FALSE.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved/gravel yard apron between the access road and the dock bank serves as an internal staging/queue area.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single open access lane in/out (entryExitTogether). entry/exit lanes = 1 each, inferred from the single open driveway in Street View.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park ~5km from downtown Hot Springs, surrounded by woods and scattered light industry. Small-town industrial setting -> Rural per rubric tiebreak.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE - sits in an established industrial park with adjacent active businesses and recent (2025) Street View capture; cellular coverage likely adequate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; access is road-only. FALSE.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~7-9 trailers backed at the main dock bank in the tight imagery (mixed orange/white tractor-trailers).
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Yard apron + dock frontage could practically hold ~30 trailers; estimate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~11.3 acres of the two-building complex + aprons derived from the perimeter polygon.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Multiple capture vintages overlap the park; the NW corner shows a grading/laydown/construction area in one tile. Dock counts read best from the z20/z21 NW-face crops; Street View (2023 + 2025) confirmed the open, ungated approach.
